steps: 1. Refresh **Tweaker: Events** from the Workshop and launch the game.
2. Open Mod Options for Tweaker: Events and scroll **Other Mutators (Chaos Wastes / Deus / misc)** and the Cursed Adventure curse groups.
3. Confirm every checkbox shows a clean game name, with no bracketed raw key text in any title or tooltip.
4. Enable **Preview Active Mutators on Tab**, check a curse with no art of its own (for example the Nurgle curse Corrupted Flesh), and hold Tab in the keep.
assertions: All modifier labels localized; every curse row in the Tab preview shows an icon matching its in-game god or curse art; name-only rows appear only where the game itself ships no icon. `issue1149_modifier_loc_icon_coverage` passes in the regression run.
In the keep run issue1149_modifier_loc_icon_coverage: every discovered mutator has a non-bracketed name and a resolvable icon.
